WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_at_return, p.category AS cat_at_return
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
), cur AS (SELECT sku, subcategory, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current)
SELECT r.sub_at_return, c.subcategory AS sub_current, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_sale_line,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < s.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty
FROM r LEFT JOIN cur c ON c.sku=r.sku LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.sub_at_return='Garden Furniture' OR c.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT sl.channel_code, coalesce(w.status,'(store)') AS order_status, count(*) AS n, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=sl.receipt_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND p.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
